item.title: DMSO Dual-Route Therapy for Refractory Tinnitus in Long-COVID and Post-COVID-19 Vaccine Injury
item.description: Enrolling By Invitation · Phase 2 · Dmso-Based Otic Solution With Betahistine, Dexamethasone, And Lidocaine, N-Acetylcysteine (NAC) — The goal of this clinical trial is to test a compounded dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO)-based dual-route therapy for adults with refractory subjective tinnitus linked to long-COVID (post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2) or post-COVID-19 vaccine injury.
